_about: Public-domain Samuel Chandler (1693-1766), Presbyterian minister at the Old Jewry, apologist, for the Word Hoard: A Vindication of the Christian Religion (1725), The History of Persecution (1736), A Vindication of the History of the Old Testament (1741), his Sermons (London 1768, four volumes) and A Critical History of the Life of David (1853 reprint), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 46 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
